notes: Mall-side entrance: the post-2012 'JCPenney' wordmark (caps J C P, lowercase 'enney' with a tall x-height) as lit red-face channel letters with dark returns, mounted on the rosso (red-brown veined) marble cladding of the entrance bay, black-framed glass doors below; cream mall wall with a terracotta wainscot either side. A potted palm hides most of the 'e'-'n' in every view. Set in TeX Gyre Heros Bold at 0.85 width (matches the word's width and the x-height); a faint red glow on the marble. Cap height ~0.8 m from the ~1.8 m marble band above the 2.4 m doors. The exterior wordmarks (magenta faces, black returns, on brick) are separate signs outside the mall and aren't built here.
